words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is doing more than linking words. The ordinary coordination reading is blocked because the preceding letter-opening supplies no syntactic peer for it to join, so the particle creates grammar after suspension rather than merely adding another item. The ayah gives only the oath object and withholds the emphatic answer until 36:3, making the oath pressure cross the verse boundary. The definite article and genitive case make it the known Quran placed under {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) as the sworn-by object, while the following adjective is locked to it by concord. Its root still matters: the local noun names a recitation that is voiced and a gathered textual body, so after the isolated letters of 36:1 the word for the gathered-recited corpus becomes the first lexical anchor. The fuʿlān shape and concrete noun behavior keep the word from flattening into a static label; the Quran is presented as a continuing recitational reality and determinate text. words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَكِيمِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥakīmi}}) is not a free-standing predicate. Its definiteness and genitive case match {{ar:ٱلْقُرْءَانِ}} ({{tr:al-qurʾāni}}), so it is the local adjective of the sworn-by Quran and stays inside the oath phrase rather than attaching forward to 36:3. The faʿīl shape gives the quality durable force: the Quran is characterized as wise, judging, and firmly perfected, not as momentarily performing an act of wisdom. The h-k-m field adds concrete pressure to that quality: wisdom includes right judgment, restraint, precise placement, and ordered construction, while unrelated branches such as delegation or bridle imagery remain outside the local adjective. The phrase also belongs to a recognizable scripture-plus-ḥakīm frame (10:1, 31:2), while 27:6 shifts the quality from a wise source to the Quranic message itself. As the final word of 36:2, {{ar:ٱلْحَكِيمِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥakīmi}}) seals the suspended oath object: after the opaque letters of 36:1, the ayah lands on ordered wisdom before the messenger assertion in 36:3.

strongest_changes: The opening object became a delivered route-pattern through the immediate sentness, straight-path, and descent sequence.
Its gathering branch became an exhaustive accounting mechanism through writing, enumeration, repeated gathering, and presentation.
The ح ك م qualifier became executable adjudication through binding speech, matched recompense, testimony, and effective command.
The late recurrence of the Qur'an noun made the opening oath a living, memory-reactivating address rather than a static title.
A compact but well-anchored branch activation heard the recitation as authorized conveyance of sovereign peace.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence changed the two-word oath from a static description into several operating mechanisms: route, register, clock, court, summons, return, and salutation. The material bridle and gestational readings remained live only with explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The return and bridle branches of ح ك م are visibly activated but remain more form-distant than wisdom, judgment, and exactness.
The time, greeting, and womb branches of ق ر ء may function as productive analogies without determining the ordinary sense of the Qur'an noun.
The surah's creative command sharpens the performative-speech model, but it should not be collapsed into the distinct act of Qur'anic recitation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Recitation as gathered and regulated motion.** `ق ر ء` B001 gathers speech into recitation and B011 supplies a directed course; `ح ك م` B001 restrains in order to set right and B004 makes firm and decisive. The later sequence of measured celestial courses (36:38-40) and the final effortless command (36:82) gives the pairing a functional analogue. I infer that the recitation's wisdom operates by gathering potentially scattered signs into a bounded course. The ayah reads as an oath by discourse that actively orders, not only discourse possessing wisdom.
2. **Decisive adjudication.** `ح ك م` B002 activates judgment among people. The packet later separates companions of the garden from criminals (36:55-64) and makes limbs testify (36:65). I supply the arrow that the recitation announces and structures that adjudication. *Al-hakim* therefore remains both wisely formed and judgment-bearing.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:38-40 unexpectedly supplied a physical analogue for `ق ر ء` B011 and `ح ك م` B001: gathered discourse behaves like bounded motion whose restraint preserves its course.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Collected recitation as a restraining instrument.** **ق ر ء B001**, specifically its variant image “gathering speech into recitation,” anchors **ٱلْقُرْءَانِ**; **ح ك م B001** anchors **ٱلْحَكِيمِ** as restraint that turns back disorder. The following sequence places the messenger on a straight path (36:3–4), makes the recitation a descent (36:5), and aims it at inherited heedlessness (36:6). The packet gives collection, restraint, path, descent, and warning; the inferred arrow is *gathered utterance → reins attention back toward the path*. The adjective thus reads functionally: the recitation is “wise” by checking drift, not merely by containing abstract wisdom.
2. **A decisive recitation whose ordering becomes visible in effects.** **ح ك م B004** (“making firm, perfected, and decisive”) gives **ٱلْحَكِيمِ** a constructional role, while **ق ر ء B011** (“manner, pattern, and directed course”) supplies an exploratory secondary scope for **ٱلْقُرْءَانِ**. The ordered progression messenger → straight course → measured descent → warning (36:3–6) is supplied; the abduction is that this progression manifests the recitation's own firm directed architecture. The oath-object can therefore be heard as a discourse whose arrangement performs decisiveness.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:7 turns **ٱلْقَوْلُ** into something that becomes due, showing that the “decisive” quality in 36:2 can culminate as binding consequence when the restraining recitation is refused.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A head-control apparatus closes around the neck, braces the chin, and fixes the head in a non-drinking, non-navigating posture.
